messages.subject: plyr function
parts:
Dear R users,

The plyr package is a powerful device for organizing data analysis.

My question is the following:

Which plyr function can I use to do following colwise categorized fivenum analysis:

data <-  attitude


Xply <- function(x, y, z, f) {
 m = x[ , -y ]
 v = apply(create_weight(do_quan(x[, y], z)),  2 , as.logical)
 K = lapply(c(1:z), function(x) m[v[, x], ])
 R1 = lapply(K, function(x) f(x))
 }

 (Xlply(data,1,4, function(x) apply(x,2, fivenum))

The analysis is not very fast. Xply used on average 2.7 miliseconds to perform a categorized colwise fivenum analysis.
